headline: Adjusted profit grows; reported EPS dips on a tough comp
summary_short: AJG's reported diluted EPS was $1.25 in Q2 FY2026, down 10.7% y/y and 60.4% q/q, while adjusted diluted EPS rose 23.5% y/y to $2.84 as total revenue grew 24% y/y to $4.00B on the AssuredPartners contribution.
summary_long: Total revenues rose 24% y/y to $4.00B (organic +5%) as AssuredPartners scaled Brokerage segment revenue to $3.50B, up 26%. Brokerage-segment net earnings margin fell to 12.9% from 18.3%; Brokerage's adjusted EBITDAC margin fell to 33.3% from 36.1%, largely because Q2 2025 included ~$144M of interest income tied to AssuredPartners acquisition financing that didn't repeat, plus higher acquisition-integration and amortization costs from the deal. Reported diluted EPS fell 10.7% y/y to $1.25; adjusted diluted EPS rose 23.5% y/y to $2.84. Cash fell slightly to $1.386B from $1.396B at year-end 2025. AJG issues no formal guidance; management did not reaffirm or change any outlook in this release.
